verbatim_normalization: Each quote is split on ' ... ' into fragments; every fragment must be a substring of the cited document's text after normalization: Unicode format characters (category Cf) removed and every run of whitespace (including line breaks and NBSP) replaced by one space, the same normalization applied to the fragment. Document text: .xls = xlrd render, every sheet, one line per row, cells joined by '|', merged cells expanded to every cell they cover, trailing empty cells dropped, integral numbers without '.0'; for a zip the text is that of the named member and the hash is the zip's; .pdf = pdftotext -layout; service JSON = response body (gunzipped when stored gzip-encoded); .html = scripts and styles removed, tags replaced by a space, entities unescaped; Confluence REST JSON = body.storage.value with tags replaced by a space, entities unescaped; the MLK 2023 image = its OCR text (rapidocr, one line per text box in reading order). verbatim_check is true only if the status, time and every corroboration quote pass.
gaps: MLK Day 2023 (2023-01-16): no CME-hosted Globex schedule naming livestock was retrievable. CME moved its 2023 holiday hours into the trading-hours service, whose Wayback captures for 2023-01-15..17 hold no events, and CME's 2023 MLK xls covers only MGEX and DME. The entry is graded secondary (AMP Futures image of CME's compact schedule, read by OCR), with CME's no-settlement notice as corroboration.

Lean Hogs (HE) from 2023-09: every service capture requests product 22 (LE) only; no capture with HE's product id exists. HE is taken to share LE's hours, as the one Livestock / LIVESTOCK row of CME's 2019-2023 schedules states for both. The bar check should test HE separately.

Captures taken before the event (CME's published plan, not a post-event record): the 2022 Labor Day, Thanksgiving compact, Christmas and 2023 New Year schedules (all 2022-07-04), the 2023 Memorial Day and Labor Day PDFs, and the 2024-12-20 service captures for 2025 dates. No later captures exist for them, except the 2022 Thanksgiving full schedule (2022-11-22), which is cited. The 2021 case shows why this matters: CME's January 2021 copy of its Christmas 2021 settlement notice listed 12:00 CT settlements for 2021-12-23 and the December 2021 copy says normal settlement times.

Christmas Eve 12:15 CT (2024-12-24, 2025-12-24): CME's service states 12:15 CT for LE while the day after Thanksgiving in the same years is 12:05 CT and CME's Christmas Eve 2026 plan (capture 2026-08-30, outside the coverage) is 12:05 CT. Encoded as CME states it; a broker page (Insignia Futures) agrees for 2024. 2025-12-24 is inside the research window and the Task 7 bar check should settle it.

Early-close times 2019 to 2020-07-02 are 12:15 CT in both CME's compact and full schedules, 12:05 CT from 2020-11-27; the change is dated only by the schedules themselves (no CME notice of it was found).

Juneteenth 2021 (Friday 2021-06-18, the first federal observance, declared 2021-06-17): CME published no holiday schedule for it in its 2021 zip; the date carries no entry and no CME-stated normal-day finding. The bar check should confirm a regular session.
No-entry findings for 2023-12-22 and 2023-12-29 rest on CME settlement notices (normal settlement times), not on a Globex hours statement.

Expiring contracts are not calendar entries: LE 'Trading terminates at 12:00 Noon CT on the last business day of the contract month' (LE contract specifications); HE terminates on the 10th business day of the contract month, and CME settles the expiring HE and LE contracts on 11:58:30-12:00:00 CT trading (CME wiki Livestock page). The roll handling, not the calendar, must cover the 12:00 CT stop of the expiring month.
